<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">T<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">hrough <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we have received <em data-td-fact-id="27405745" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$58.6</em> million in license fees, research and development funding and cost reimbursements and milestones under this agreement. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>&nbsp;</i></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>PepsiCo</i><font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i> (Sweet)</i><i>. </i>In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> August 2010 </em>we entered into a collaboration agreement with PepsiCo. The agreement relates to a research program to discover and develop (<em data-td-fact-id="27405746" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em>) novel natural and artificial flavor ingredients intended to modify the sweet taste of sucrose and fructose, including high fructose corn syrup, and (<em data-td-fact-id="27405747" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em>) natural HIS, in each case for use in non-alcoholic beverage product categories on a worldwide basis. Under the agreement, we received an upfront payment of <em data-td-fact-id="27405748" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$30.0</em> million from PepsiCo, <em data-td-fact-id="27405749" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$7.5</em>&nbsp;million of which was paid in the <em data-td-fact-id="27405750" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">second</em> quarter of <em data-td-fact-id="27405751" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2010</em> in connection with the signing of a letter agreement between the parties and <em data-td-fact-id="27405752" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$22.5</em> million of which was paid in the <em data-td-fact-id="27405753" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">third</em> quarter of <em data-td-fact-id="27405754" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2010.</em> The upfront payment is being recognized over the entire research period of the agreement. We received</font><font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> <em data-td-fact-id="27405755" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$32.0</em> million in research and development payments over the initial <em data-td-fact-id="27405756" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">four</em>-year research period. We are also entitled to milestone payments and reimbursement of certain out-of-pocket expenses. Upon commercialization, we are entitled to minimum annual royalties during specified periods of time and/or royalty payments on products that incorporate selected flavor ingredients and/or natural HIS. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> May 2014, </em>PepsiCo exercised its option to extend the research period for an additional <em data-td-fact-id="27405757" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> years through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> August 2016</em><font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">, which entitled us to <em data-td-fact-id="27405758" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$17.6</em> million in committed research funding to be paid in quarterly installments over the additional <em data-td-fact-id="27405759" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em>-year period.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 2016, </em>we entered into a Letter Agreement with PepsiCo to extend the research period <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">for an additional <em data-td-fact-id="27405760" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">45</em> days through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September 2016 </em>at the same research funding rate provided under the agreement. We received research funding of <em data-td-fact-id="27405761" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.1</em> million during the extension period. Except for this extension, all other terms and conditions of the collaboration agreement remained unchanged and continued in full force and effect.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September </em><font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="27405762" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> we amended and restated the collaboration agreement to extend PepsiCo&rsquo;s research funding for our natural sweet taste program for an additional <em data-td-fact-id="27405763" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years, through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September 2019. </em>Under the agreement, we will receive up to <em data-td-fact-id="27405764" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$18.0</em> million in research and development payments, payable in equal quarterly installments over the <em data-td-fact-id="27405765" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em>-year research period beginning <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> October 2016. </em>In addition, PepsiCo has also agreed to reimburse us for certain specified out-of-pocket expenses that we <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>incur during the course of the research program. PepsiCo has the option to extend the natural sweet taste research program for <em data-td-fact-id="27405766" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> additional years, which would result in additional research funding commitments and payments during the extension of the research program.&nbsp;PepsiCo will have non-exclusive rights for commercial development of natural sweeteners and natural sweet enhancers discovered, developed and selected under the collaboration for use in all non-alcoholic beverage categories on a worldwide basis. We will be eligible for milestone payments based on the achievement of predetermined goals as well as royalty payments upon the sale of products containing natural sweeteners or natural sweet enhancers selected under the collaboration.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In connection with this agreement, <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">we recognized development revenues of <em data-td-fact-id="27405767" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.4</em> million, <em data-td-fact-id="27405768" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$9.3</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="27405769" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$10.0</em> million for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="27405770" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27405771" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> respectively. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Th<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">rough <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we have received <em data-td-fact-id="27405772" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$95.7</em> million in upfront fees, research and development funding, cost reimbursements and milestones under this agreement. Including the remaining research and development funding, we are entitled to an additional <em data-td-fact-id="27405773" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$10.5</em> million for a total of <em data-td-fact-id="27405774" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$106.2</em>&nbsp;million.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Firmenich (Cool). </i><font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="27405775" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2007,</em> we entered into a collaboration agreement with Firmenich to work for a <em data-td-fact-id="27405776" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em>-year collaborative period to discover and develop novel flavor ingredients that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be used by Firmenich on an exclusive basis worldwide to impart a cool taste in flavor systems. In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 2010, </em>we amended the agreement to extend the collaborative period until <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 2012. </em>In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 2012, </em>we amended the agreement to extend the collaborative period until <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 2013, </em>which marked the end of the collaborative period. Under the agreement, Firmenich agreed to pay research fees and specified payments upon the achievement of milestones. Firmenich also agreed to reimburse us for a portion of the costs associated with the development and regulatory approval process of flavor ingredients that it selects for development, as well as a portion of certain expenses that we incur related to the research program. In addition, following the receipt of regulatory approval in <em data-td-fact-id="27405777" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2014</em> of a discovered flavor ingredient, we are entitled to minimum periodic royalties and royalties on sales of products containing the discovered flavor ingredient until the expiration of relevant patents. In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 2017, </em>we amended the agreement to grant Firmenich an exclusive license to an additional approved flavor ingredient and related analogs, and to expand the licensed product categories to include all applications in the flavor, oral care and consumer product markets. In addition, the amendment suspended Firmenich&rsquo;s royalty obligations from <em data-td-fact-id="27405778" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> through <em data-td-fact-id="27405779" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2020,</em> such royalty obligations shall resume on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 1, 2021. </em>In exchange for the exclusive license, expansion of rights and suspension of royalty obligations, we received a nonrefundable cash payment of <em data-td-fact-id="27405780" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$10.0</em> million in <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 2017.</em></font></p>

We are entitled to receive royalties on future net sales of products containing a discovered flavor ingredient beginning in <em data-td-fact-id="27405782" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2021</em> until the expiration of relevant patents. Any future royalties under this collaboration are uncertain and difficult to predict.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-fact-id="27405796" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">6</em></b><font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>. Stockholders</b><b>&rsquo;</b><b> Equity</b></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>Convertible Preferred Stock</i></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Our<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> certificate of incorporation, as amended and restated, authorizes us to issue up to <em data-td-fact-id="27405797" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">7,500,000</em> shares of preferred stock, with a par value of <em data-td-fact-id="27405798" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.001,</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27405799" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> or more series. Our Board of Directors <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>authorize the issuance of convertible preferred stock with voting or conversion rights that could adversely affect the voting power or other rights of the holders of the common stock. The issuance of convertible preferred stock, while providing flexibility in connection with possible acquisitions and other corporate purposes, could, among other things, have the effect of delaying, deferring or preventing a change in control of the company and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>adversely affect the market price of the common stock and the voting and other rights of the holders of common stock. <em data-td-fact-id="27405800" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> shares of convertible preferred stock were outstanding as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>or <em data-td-fact-id="27405801" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>&nbsp;</i></b></p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt;">69</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>Equity Incentive Plan</i></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">adopted the <em data-td-fact-id="27405802" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Equity Incentive Plan in connection with our initial public offering and adopted the <em data-td-fact-id="27405803" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Equity Incentive Plan effective for grants beginning <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 1, 2014 (</em>collectively, the &ldquo;Plan&rdquo;). The Plan provides for the grant of incentive and non-statutory stock options and restricted stock purchase rights to our employees, directors and consultants. The Plan, as amended, authorizes us to issue up to <em data-td-fact-id="27405804" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">18,935,450</em>&nbsp;shares of common stock. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="27405805" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2,801,407</em>&nbsp;shares remain available for grant under the Plan. We issue new shares of common stock upon the exercise of stock options.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Plan allows <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">us to grant restricted stock purchase rights at <em data-td-fact-id="27405806" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> less than <em data-td-fact-id="27405807" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">85%</em> of the fair value of our common stock as determined by our Board of Directors at the date of the grant. All restricted stock purchase rights vest in accordance with a vesting schedule&nbsp;determined by our Board of Directors, typically over a <em data-td-fact-id="27405808" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">four</em>-year period. Since the Plan&rsquo;s inception, <em data-td-fact-id="27405809" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">457,069</em> restricted stock purchase rights have been granted at exercise prices ranging from <em data-td-fact-id="27405810" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.35</em> to <em data-td-fact-id="27405811" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.94</em> per share, all of which have been exercised as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017. </em>We have repurchased a total of <em data-td-fact-id="27405812" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">131,152</em>&nbsp;shares since the Plan&rsquo;s inception and <em data-td-fact-id="27405813" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> shares are subject to repurchase at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017. </em><em data-td-fact-id="27405814" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> restricted stock purchase rights were granted during the <em data-td-fact-id="27405815" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Options granted under the Plan generally expire <em data-td-fact-id="27405816" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> later than <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="27405817" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">10</em> years from the date of grant (<em data-td-fact-id="27405818" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em> years for a <em data-td-fact-id="27405819" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">10%</em> stockholder). Options generally vest and become fully exercisable over a period of <em data-td-fact-id="27405820" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">four</em> years. In certain cases, grants to officers, directors and consultants can be made fully exercisable at the date of grant. The exercise price of incentive stock options must be equal to at least the fair value of our common stock on the date of grant, and the exercise price of non-statutory stock options <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be <em data-td-fact-id="27405821" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> less than <em data-td-fact-id="27405822" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">85%</em> of the fair value of our common stock on the date of grant. The exercise price of any option granted to a <em data-td-fact-id="27405823" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">10%</em> stockholder <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be <em data-td-fact-id="27405824" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> less than <em data-td-fact-id="27405825" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">110%</em> of the fair value of our common stock on the date of grant. We have an option to repurchase all unvested shares at the original purchase price for any reason upon the voluntary or involuntary termination of employment with us or consulting services provided to us. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="27405826" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> shares of common stock were unvested and subject to repurchase.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The following is a summary of stock option <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">activity under the Plan through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017: </em></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The aggregate intrinsic value <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">represents the difference between the closing market price of our common stock at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>of <em data-td-fact-id="27405827" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.30</em> and the exercise price of in-the-money options. The total intrinsic value of options exercised was zero, <em data-td-fact-id="27405828" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.4</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="27405829" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.8</em> million during the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="27405830" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27405831" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> respectively. We received zero, <em data-td-fact-id="27405832" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.6</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="27405833" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2.1</em> million in proceeds from the exercise of stock options during the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="27405834" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27405835" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> respectively.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>E</i></b><font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>mployee Stock Purchase</i></b><b><i> Plan</i></b></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">During <em data-td-fact-id="27405836" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004,</em> <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">we adopted the <em data-td-fact-id="27405837" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Employee Stock Purchase Plan (the &ldquo;Purchase Plan&rdquo;), which allows all eligible employees to purchase shares of our common stock at the lower of: (i) <em data-td-fact-id="27405838" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">85%</em> of the fair market value on the <em data-td-fact-id="27405839" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> day of a <em data-td-fact-id="27405840" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em>-year offering period; or (ii) <em data-td-fact-id="27405841" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">85%</em> of the fair market value on the last date of each <em data-td-fact-id="27405842" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">six</em>-month purchase period within the <em data-td-fact-id="27405843" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em>-year offering period. Employees <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>authorize us to withhold up to <em data-td-fact-id="27405844" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">15%</em> of their compensation during any purchase period, subject to certain limitations. The Purchase Plan authorizes up to <em data-td-fact-id="27405845" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">5,633,096</em> shares to be granted. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="27405846" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">4,273,972</em> shares of common stock have been issued under the Purchase Plan at an average price of <em data-td-fact-id="27405847" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2.44</em> per share.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>&nbsp;</i></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>E</i></b><font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>quity Purchase Agreement</i></b></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 2016, </em>we entered into a purchase agreement with Lincoln Park Capital Fund, L<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">LC (&ldquo;LPC&rdquo;), whereby we had the right to sell to LPC from time to time in our sole discretion up to <em data-td-fact-id="27405848" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$14</em> million in shares of our common stock through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 20, 2018, </em>subject to certain limitations and conditions set forth in the agreement. During the year ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we sold <em data-td-fact-id="27405849" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2,000,000</em> shares to LPC for gross cash proceeds of <em data-td-fact-id="27405850" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2.1</em> million. In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 2017, </em>we terminated the purchase agreement with LPC. There were <em data-td-fact-id="27405851" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> cancellation fess associated with the termination of the purchase agreement. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">At <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we had Federal and California tax net operating loss carryforwards of approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27405859" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$116.1</em>&nbsp;million and <em data-td-fact-id="27405860" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$99.3</em>&nbsp;million, respectively. The Federal and California tax loss carryforwards will begin to expire in <em data-td-fact-id="27405861" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2019</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27405862" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018,</em> respectively, unless previously utilized. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">At <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we also had Federal and California research and development tax credit carryforwards of approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27405863" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$9.9</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="27405864" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$8.7</em> million, respectively. The Federal credit carryforward will begin to expire in <em data-td-fact-id="27405865" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2021</em> unless previously utilized and the California credit will carry forward indefinitely until utilized.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We have<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> analyzed filing positions in all of the Federal and state jurisdictions where we are required to file income tax returns for all open tax years in these jurisdictions. Our analysis concluded that, due to past ownership changes, our deferred tax assets for net operating losses and research and development credits will be subject to an annual limitation. As such, <em data-td-fact-id="27405866" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3.1</em> million of net operating losses will expire and <em data-td-fact-id="27405867" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$944,000</em> of research and development credits will expire for Federal purposes as a result of the multiple ownership changes which occurred in prior years. As a result of the completion of the analysis, we have included the net operating loss and research and development credit carryforward net of the amount to be expired as a deferred tax asset. However, we have determined that sufficient future taxable income <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em><em data-td-fact-id="27405868" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be available to realize the deferred tax assets for net operating loss and research and development credit carryforwards. Therefore, we have recognized a full valuation allowance for these deferred tax assets. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> updated our Section <em data-td-fact-id="27405869" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">382</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27405870" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">383</em> analyses through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and determined that there has <em data-td-fact-id="27405871" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> been a subsequent ownership change since <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 2007. </em>The completion of our Section <em data-td-fact-id="27405872" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">382</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27405873" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">383</em> analyses through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>does <em data-td-fact-id="27405874" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> prevent further limitations to our net operating loss and research and development credit carryforwards. Additional limitations <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>arise if we experience an ownership change in subsequent periods.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 22, 2017, </em>the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act was signed into legislation. <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We estimate there is <em data-td-fact-id="27405875" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> impact to net income tax expense or income tax payable as a result of this legislation for the year ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>as we recognized a full valuation allowance on the deferred tax assets. However, we will continue to make and refine our calculations as additional analysis is completed. In addition, our estimates <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>also be affected as we gain a more thorough understanding of the tax law.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We remeasured certain deferred tax assets and liabilities based on the rates at which they are expected to reverse in the futu<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">re, which is generally <em data-td-fact-id="27405876" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">21%.</em> The provisional amount recorded related to the remeasurement of our deferred tax balance was <em data-td-fact-id="27405877" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$28.7</em> million, of which is fully offset by a corresponding decrease to our valuation allowance. However, we are still analyzing certain aspects of the Act and refining our calculations, which could potentially affect the measurement of these balances or potentially give rise to new deferred tax amounts.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In the next <em data-td-fact-id="27405878" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">twelve</em> months, we do <em data-td-fact-id="27405879" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> expect a significant change in our unrecognized tax benefits. <font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Due&nbsp;to&nbsp;the existence of the valuation allowance, future changes in unrecognized&nbsp;tax benefits will <em data-td-fact-id="27405880" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> impact our&nbsp;effective tax rate.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We are<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> subject to taxation in the United States and state jurisdictions. Our tax years for <em data-td-fact-id="27405881" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2014</em> and forward are subject to examination by the IRS and tax years <em data-td-fact-id="27405882" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> and forward are subject to examination by California tax authorities. Due to the carryforward of unutilized net operating losses and research and development credits, the IRS and the California tax authorities <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>go back to the taxable years in which the net operating losses and research and development credits became available to recompute such amounts, but <em data-td-fact-id="27405883" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> redetermine the tax liability for such years. We are currently <em data-td-fact-id="27405884" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> under examination by any taxing authorities. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> recognize interest and penalties related to income tax matters in income tax expense. For the <em data-td-fact-id="27405885" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we did <em data-td-fact-id="27405886" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> recognize any interest or penalties.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Conclusion Regarding the Effectiveness of Disclosure Controls and Procedures</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Under the supervision and with the participation of our management, including our principal executive officer and principal financial officer, we conducted an evaluation of our disclosure controls and procedures, as such term is defined under Rule<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;13a-15(e) promulgated under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or the Exchange Act. Based on this evaluation, our principal executive officer and our principal financial officer concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures were effective as of the end of the period covered by this annual report.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Management<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting</font></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Our management is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting, as such term is defined in Exchange Act Rule 13a-15(f). Under the supervision and with the participation of our manageme<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">nt, including our Chief Executive Officer and our Vice President, Finance we conducted an evaluation of the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting based on the framework in <i>Internal Control - Integrated Framework </i>issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (2013 framework). Based on our evaluation under the framework in <i>Internal Control &mdash; Integrated Framework</i>, our management concluded that our internal control over financial reporting was effective as of December 31, 2017.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">This Annual Report on Form 10-K does not include an attestation report of our independent registered public accounting firm regarding internal control over financial reporting. We were not required to have, nor have we, engaged our independent registered public accounting firm to perform an audit of internal control over financial reporting pursuant to SEC rules that permit us to provide only management&#39;s report in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Changes in Internal Control Over Financial Reporting</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">There was no<font style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> change in our internal control over financial reporting during our most recent fiscal quarter that has materially affected, or is reasonably likely to materially affect, our internal controls over financial reporting.&nbsp;</font></p>
